capabilities: Paste a URL from the clipboard onto selected text
Insert selected text into a pasted link via command palette or hotkey
extras: README is brief; a demo image was removed and the reverse command's hotkey must be set manually.
problem: Obsidian's paste replaces selected text instead of turning the selection into a link, making it tedious to attach a URL to existing words.
summary: Paste helper that wraps selected text with a URL from the clipboard on Ctrl/Cmd+V, and can insert selected text into a pasted link.
